description.narrative: The main project-level impact involves helping IndiGrid optimize its capital structure and efficiently enhance the operation and reliability of transmission assets as it expands its portfolio. Beyond the Project, the investment is expected to enhance market integration by visibly demonstrating the role of InvITs in expanding and diversifying sources of investment in the power sector.

The proposed investment comprises of a subscription by IFC of up to US$150 million to Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) issued by India Grid Trust (IndiGrid or the Company). These NCDs will be rated, listed, secured, redeemable and denominated in Indian Rupees. The proceeds will be used by the Company to support its investments or loan infusion in Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs) that house the transmission assets which are compliant with IFCs performance standards (PS). These investments are being used to refinance existing debt at these SPVs.

name.narrative: The proceeds will be used by IndiGrid to support its investments or loan infusion in Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs) that house the following transmission assets which are compliant with IFCs performance standards (PS). These investments are being used to refinance existing project level debt at these SPVs. # SPV Project Details 1 Jabalpur Transmission Company Ltd. (JTCL) JTCL operates two EHV overhead transmission lines of approximately 992 ckms in the states of Chhattisgarh and Madhya Pradesh comprising one 765 kV double circuit line of approximately 757 ckms from Dharamjaigarh (Chhattisgarh) to Jabalpur (Madhya Pradesh) and one 765 kV single circuit line of approximately 235 ckms from Jabalpur to Bina in Madhya Pradesh. 2 RAPP Transmission Company Ltd. (RTCL) RTCL operates one EHV overhead transmission line of approximately 403 ckms in the states of Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh, comprised of one 400 kV D/C line from Rajasthan to Madhya Pradesh. 3 Odisha Generation Phase II Transmission Ltd. (OGPTL) OGPTL operates two EHV overhead transmission lines of approximately 711 ckms in the states of Chhattisgarh and Odisha comprising one 400 kV double circuit line of approximately 103 ckms from Jharsuguda (Chhattisgarh) to OPGC (Odisha) and one 765 kV double circuit line of approximately 608 ckms from Raipur to Jharsuguda in Chhattisgarh. 4 Purulia & Kharagpur Transmission Company Ltd. (PKTCL) PKTCL operates two EHV overhead transmission lines with a total circuit length of approximately 545 ckms in the states of West Bengal and Jharkhand, comprising one 400 kV D/C line of approximately 322 ckms from Kharagpur (West Bengal) to Chaibasa (Jharkhand) and one 400 kV D/C line of approximately 223 ckms from Purulia (West Bengal) to Ranchi (Jharkhand). 5 Maheshwaram Transmission Ltd. (MTL) MTL operates two EHV overhead transmission lines with a total circuit length of approximately 476 ckms in the state of Telangana, comprising one 400kV D/C line of approximately 197 ckms from Maheshwaram to Mehboob Nagar in Telangana and one 400kV D/C line of approximately 279 ckms from Nizamabad to Yeddumailaram in Telangana. MTL also has four 400kV line bays.
